problem:
Consider the system of linear equations

$$
{\begin{aligned} & 4x+12y=-4 \\  & 5x+11y=3.\end{aligned}
$$

Use the standard method of Gaussian elimination to reduce the augmented matrix $M$ of the system to row echelon form.

feedback.problem:
Consider the system of linear equations

$$
{\begin{aligned} & 2x+7y=-5 \\  & 7x+11y=-4.\end{aligned}
$$

Use the standard method of Gaussian elimination to reduce the augmented matrix $M$ of the system to row echelon form.
feedback.worked_solution:
The augmented matrix for this system is

$$
M=[\begin{aligned}2 & 7 & -5 \\ 7 & 11 & -4\end{aligned}].
$$

Reducing $M$ to row echelon form, we have

$$
\begin{aligned}M & ∼[\begin{aligned}2 & 7 & -5 \\ 7 & 11 & -4\end{aligned}] & {R}_{1} & :=\frac{1}{2}{R}_{1} \\  & ∼[\begin{aligned}1 & \frac{7}{2} & -\frac{5}{2} \\ 7 & 11 & -4\end{aligned}] & {R}_{2} & :={R}_{2}-7{R}_{1} \\  & ∼[\begin{aligned}1 & \frac{7}{2} & -\frac{5}{2} \\ 0 & -\frac{27}{2} & \frac{27}{2}\end{aligned}] & {R}_{2} & :=-\frac{2}{27}{R}_{2} \\  & ∼[\begin{aligned}1 & \frac{7}{2} & -\frac{5}{2} \\ 0 & 1 & -1\end{aligned}].\end{aligned}
$$
